import sys

MOD = 998244353
stirling = [[0] * 5001 for _ in range(5001)]
stirling[0][0] = 1

for i in range(1, 5001):
    for j in range(1, 5001):
        stirling[i][j] = (stirling[i - 1][j - 1] + j * stirling[i - 1][j]) % MOD

def modInverse(x, p):
    return power(x, p - 2, p)

def power(x, y, p):
    res = 1
    x = x % p
    while y > 0:
        if y % 2 == 1:
            res = (res * x) % p
        y >>= 1
        x = (x * x) % p
    return res

def main():
    input_line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    n_str, m_str, k_str = input_line.split()
    n = int(n_str)
    m = int(m_str)
    k = int(k_str)
    p = modInverse(m, MOD)
    val = 1
    ans = 0
    prob = 1
    for i in range(k, 0, -1):
        val *= (n - (k - i))
        val %= MOD
        prob *= p
        prob %= MOD
        ans += ((val * prob) % MOD) * stirling[k][k - i + 1]
        ans %= MOD
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
